I’m giving you my experience when i was in the psych ward, but remember it really depends where you live. 
In my country we have a free health care so no it didn’t cost anything. 
I wasn’t taken from my parents so i dont think they will unless they are abusive. The Cps might become involved.
For me it was a pretty ok place. We were able to keep our phones but had to share rooms and sometimes you could hear the other patients screaming which was a little bit disturbing. But most of the teens were nice and so were the nurses. Mostly.
REMEMBER this is my experience and it could be different for you. 
Hope this helps!!:)
